desc: Read N, Q, array A[2..N], and queries (u_i, v_i).
Precompute factorial (N-1)! mod MOD, modular inverses of k for k=1..N, and prefix array S[t] = sum_{k=2}^t A_k * inv(k) mod MOD.
For each query (u, v) with u<v, compute ans = fact * (A[v] + A[u]*(u-1)%MOD * inv(u) % MOD + S[v-1] - S[u]) mod MOD; for u=1, the A[u] term is 0 and S[u]=S[1]=0.
